raw:
```sql
SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating)
FROM main."Player_Attributes" pa
WHERE CAST(pa."date" AS DATE) <= '2015-09-21'
  AND pa.id IN (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.id)
    FROM main."Player_Attributes" pa2
    WHERE CAST(pa2."date" AS DATE) <= '2015-09-21'
    GROUP BY pa2.player_api_id
  )
```
